description: This is a unit test PHP class for the OrangeHRM project, specifically testing namespace conventions within core essential tests. It checks that test classes are within expected namespace patterns and reports any that are not.

classes.name: UnitTestsNamespaceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class that checks for proper namespace usage of test classes within the OrangeHRM core essential tests.

methods.name: testUnitTestsNamespace
methods.description: Identifies classes within the project that are placed in invalid namespaces according to the specified pattern and throws an exception listing them.
